penalties.details: BSE vide its email dated June 30, 2026, has imposed fine of Rs. 59,000/- (basic fine plus GST) on the Company for non-submission of the audited financial results for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026 within the period prescribed under Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The Company shall make the payment of the fine within the timelines prescribed by BSE
penalties.impact: The Company has submitted the audited financial results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter and year ended March 31, 2026 to the Stock Exchanges on June 11, 2026. The said delay in submission of audited financial results was on account of the changes occurred in the Key Managerial Personnel and rotation of Statutory Auditors of the Company. There is no impact on the financial, operation or other activities of the Company due to levy of the said fine.

operating_notes.text: Allen Joseph Andrade resigned as CFO effective close of business October 15, 2026, but remains as Financial Advisor.
Debabrata Das, a Chartered Accountant with 20+ years in energy, city gas and infrastructure finance, joins as CFO on October 16, 2026.
The board meeting on October 13, 2026 ran from 2.45 p.m. to 3.30 p.m.
HOEC took over operations and ownership of the Hollong Modular Gas Processing Plant (HMGPP) in the Dirok field from Expro North Sea Limited.

timeline.summary: Hindustan Oil Exploration received an administrative warning letter from SEBI on May 4, 2026, for a delayed disclosure regarding a ₹15.12 crore bank guarantee.
HOEC begins resale of B-80 crude oil cargo to third party (May 18, 2026)
HOEC refers HPCL crude oil dispute to conciliation (May 18, 2026)
Hindustan Oil Exploration Company Limited’s **Baroruchi Mishra (Managing Director & CEO)** scheduled an earnings call for June 12, 2026, to discuss audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results.
On October 13, 2026, HOEC's board appointed Debabrata Das as CFO effective October 16, 2026 and noted Allen Joseph Andrade's resignation effective close of business October 15, 2026.
On October 14, 2026, HOEC took over the operations and ownership of the Hollong Modular Gas Processing Plant in Assam from Expro North Sea Limited.
